texts.preamble: Amara Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 14 June, 2021
texts.facts: Thereupon, this Court had granted stay of operation of the said notification by way of various orders including the order dated 15.10.2020 in W.P.No.16118 of 2020 dated 15.10.2020 in W.P.No.15881 of 2020.
texts.arguments: | The petitioner, who is said to be dealing with tobacco, has approached this Court Amara Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 14 June, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55963386/ 2 challenging the notification and consequential action of the respondents in seeking to interfere with the business of the petitioner. The learned Government Pleader for Medical and Health submits that the issued notification has expired and the Food Commissioner has already issued a circular directing the authorities not to interfere with the business of the dealers who are dealing with the products covered under the said notification, The learned Government Pleader further submits that even though the notification has expired, the Government is intent on pursuing the writ petitions order to obtain a clear exposition of law on this issue.
texts.petitioner_arguments: | The petitioner, who is said to be dealing with tobacco, has approached this Court Amara Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 14 June, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55963386/ 2 challenging the notification and consequential action of the respondents in seeking to interfere with the business of the petitioner. The learned Government Pleader for Medical and Health submits that the issued notification has expired and the Food Commissioner has already issued a circular directing the authorities not to interfere with the business of the dealers who are dealing with the products covered under the said notification, The learned Government Pleader further submits that even though the notification has expired, the Government is intent on pursuing the writ petitions order to obtain a clear exposition of law on this issue.
